name: Fire Rose & The Nesting Doors
description:
The genesis release of The Sterling Method™. Fire Rose & The Nesting Doors is a creator sanctuary on Ethereum where artists, musicians and storytellers publish their own NFT page inside a door. Every door nests inside the one before it, and every sale pays forward: 70% to the creator, 15% to the owner of the door it lives inside, 15% to the Founder Vault. The splits are written into the contract, so no one, including the founder, can change them.

Two Master Genesis Apps (#1 and #2) are the roots of the two universes. Claim your door at lxfe.io.
